intervals.note: The Academia Sinica news item says TEXONO 'launched an additional dark matter research program in 2004'; the first dark-matter limits came from a 2006-07 data set (arXiv:0712.1645). The final reactor-ON neutrino data end in April 2023 (the Kuo-Sheng power station was decommissioned in March 2023); the 2026 paper says KSNL 'remains operational' for background studies and detector R&D and that the programme will continue at the Sanmen Reactor Neutrino Laboratory (RECODE). Recorded as active on that basis; no source states whether dark-matter-oriented germanium data taking continues.

Scope: this record covers the TEXONO germanium dark-matter programme at the Kuo-Sheng Reactor Neutrino Laboratory. TEXONO's neutrino-physics programme at the same site (CsI(Tl) neutrino-electron scattering, neutrino magnetic moment, CEvNS searches such as arXiv:2411.18812 and 2606.16864) is not recorded in detail here; the neutrino stream may extend or merge this record (listed for the integrator).

CDEX descends from this programme: the 2016 TEXONO overview says its first decade 'laid the foundation' for CJPL and CDEX and that CDEX-1 adopted the KSNL baseline design; the lineage row is on experiment:cdex-1.

The 2013 pPCGe limits and the CoGeNT region: the abstract says 'Part of the parameter space in cross-section versus WIMP-mass implied by various experiments is probed and excluded'; it does not name CoGeNT. The Academia Sinica news item (institution page, not quoted as a result) says the results 'refute evidence presented by the CoGeNT Collaboration', which is the news office's wording.

physics_goals.quote: The themes of the research programs of the TEXONO (Taiwan EXperiment On NeutrinO) Collaboration are on the studies of low energy neutrino and dark matter physics.
physics_goals.value: Reactor-neutrino and dark-matter studies with sub-keV germanium detectors

summary.plain: TEXONO is a Taiwan-led experiment at a nuclear power plant that uses germanium detectors sensitive to energies of a few hundred electron-volts. Besides studying reactor neutrinos, it set limits on very light dark matter and tested the claim by the CoGeNT experiment.
summary.technical: Sub-keV germanium detectors at the Kuo-Sheng Reactor Neutrino Laboratory (30 m.w.e., 28 m from a 2.9 GW reactor core): 4-channel 5 g ULEGe array at 220 eV threshold (0.338 kg d; limits for 3-6 GeV WIMPs), 840 g fiducial p-type point-contact Ge at 39.5 kg d (spin-independent limits that probe the CoGeNT region), and an n-type point-contact Ge (314.15 kg d) for bosonic super-WIMPs. The same detectors serve reactor-neutrino and CEvNS searches; CDEX adopted the KSNL design.
